item.title: Defense in Phan murder retrial questions when Middlesex DA knew about investigator’s blood alcohol content in fatal crash
item.description: LOWELL — The timing of when prosecutors learned that a key State Police investigator in the Phan brothers' murder case was allegedly under the influence of alcohol during a fatal on-duty crash emerged as a central issue during a hearing Monday in Middlesex Superior Court.

item.title: Ask the Psychic: Could my dad be golfing in Heaven?
item.description: DEAR BONNIE: Can our loved ones do whatever they were passionate about here on earth in Heaven? I went to see a medium, and she told me my dad was golfing on the other side. item.title: Editorial: Don’t let loss take shine off Patriots’ remarkable ride
item.description: The clock struck 12 on our New England Patriots’ Cinderella season Sunday night at about 7:30 Pacific Coast time, a surprisingly successful journey upended by a superior Seattle Seahawks team in Super Bowl LX. The score indicated a 29-13 defeat, but it wasn’t indicative of the NFC champion’s dominance.
